source.title: The team meeting (ladder unit, machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Spanish written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. The English lines are the drafter's own.
source.licenseNote: Owned by the course authors; machine-drafted, not yet native-reviewed.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. For the Honduran reviewer: "¿Podés venir?" (vos); "No puedo, tengo que trabajar" (polite refusal); "Vamos a orar" and "Gracias a Dios" (prayer language, kept very simple and for the reviewer to check); the PLAN says Saturday, but sábado is not yet in the word list, so the meeting is simply "hoy".

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Hoy es la reunión del equipo en la iglesia.
sentences.english: Today is the team meeting at the church.
Pastor Jorge is here.

sentences.text: Sam, Ana, Daniel y Karla están aquí.
sentences.english: Sam, Ana, Daniel and Karla are here.

sentences.text: Hay gente en la calle que necesita comida.
sentences.english: There are people in the street who need food.
They are all hungry.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: Good afternoon, everyone.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: Thank you for coming.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: Let us pray.
The pastor prays to God.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: God, thank you for our team.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Gracias por nuestra reunión y por nuestros vecinos.
sentences.english: Thank you for our meeting and for our neighbours.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: Now let us talk.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: El lunes vamos a visitar a las familias.
sentences.english: On Monday we are going to visit the families.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Tenemos que salir a las ocho.
sentences.english: We have to leave at eight.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Where are we going to visit?

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: En la calle, con los vecinos.
sentences.english: In the street, with the neighbours.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Hay familias cerca y hay familias lejos.
sentences.english: There are families near and families far away.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: Yo puedo visitar a las familias cerca.
sentences.english: I can visit the families nearby.

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Yo no puedo venir el lunes.
sentences.english: I cannot come on Monday.

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Tengo que trabajar en la clínica.
sentences.english: I have to work at the clinic.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: That is fine, Daniel.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: Can you come at night?

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.english: Yes, at night, yes.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Yo siempre estoy en el hospital los lunes.
sentences.english: I am always at the hospital on Mondays.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.english: I am not coming on Monday.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.english: I have to go to the hospital.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: That is fine, Ana.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Sam, ¿vas a ir a la casa del señor Mario?
sentences.english: Sam, are you going to go to Mr. Mario's house?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Yes, I will go.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.english: I am going with Sam.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: El señor Mario es mi papá.
sentences.english: Mr. Mario is my dad.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: La familia del señor Mario es muy buena.
sentences.english: Mr. Mario's family is very good.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Sí, y su casa está cerca.
sentences.english: Yes, and their house is near.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: How do we get to the families far away?

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: By bus.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Vamos a esperar el autobús en la terminal.
sentences.english: We are going to wait for the bus at the terminal.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: We have to buy the tickets.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.english: Is it expensive?

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: No, the ticket is cheap.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Los catrachos siempre dan pan y café a la gente.
sentences.english: Hondurans always give bread and coffee to people.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: We give chicken and plantains.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Compramos el pollo en la tienda del señor Carlos.
sentences.english: We buy the chicken at Mr. Carlos's shop.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: Y los plátanos en la pulpería de la señora Elena.
sentences.english: And the plantains at señora Elena's shop.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: La pulpería está cerca de la iglesia.
sentences.english: The shop is near the church.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: What time do we arrive?

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: We arrive at ten.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: What do we do now?

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: Now we have to pray.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: We always say thank you to God.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Thank you for the meeting, pastor.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: Goodbye, everyone.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.english: Goodbye, pastor.

sentences.text: Todos toman café y comen pan.
sentences.english: Everyone has coffee and eats bread.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Mi mamá hace pan para todos.
sentences.english: My mom makes bread for everyone.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: How nice!

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I like the bread.

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.english: My family is not here.

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Pero el equipo es mi familia.
sentences.english: But the team is my family.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Sí, ustedes son mi familia también.
sentences.english: Yes, you are my family too.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: Sam, ¿querés venir a mi casa hoy?
sentences.english: Sam, do you want to come to my house today?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I cannot today, Karla.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I have to study Spanish.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.english: And tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Tomorrow, yes.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Voy a venir a las cuatro.
sentences.english: I am going to come at four.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: Mi mamá hace baleadas muy buenas.
sentences.english: My mom makes very good baleadas.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: How nice!

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I am very hungry.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: Mi papá dice que vos sos de la familia.
sentences.english: My dad says you are part of the family.
